findings.evidence: All declarations use `[Fintype ι]` at line 51, while `isOpenEmbedding_complexTorusAmbient` itself requires `[Finite ι]` in Topology.lean:192; for infinite products the nonzero-coordinate locus need not be open.
findings.fix: State that `ι` is finite (or that the presentation is finite) in the opening description.
findings.issue: The module docstring says any free presentation gives an open embedding and manifold chart, omitting the required finite index hypothesis.

findings.evidence: `continuous_characterEvaluation` at lines 80–84 uses `continuous_complexTorus_apply`; the Laurent formula is used at lines 123–130 in `continuous_complexTorusCoordinates_symm`.
findings.fix: Replace this paragraph with the actual role of the formula: proving `continuous_complexTorusCoordinates_symm`.
findings.issue: The docstring incorrectly says continuity of character evaluations follows from the Laurent-monomial formula; it follows directly from the induced pointwise topology, while that formula establishes continuity of the inverse coordinate map.

summary: The topology scope has been corrected, but two module-level claims remain inaccurate about hypotheses and how continuity is obtained.
